text:
maria.p: Heads up — new Shadow Traffic rollout (encoder v2 -> shadow) just hit prod. Seeing encoder pods OOMCrashLoop on two nodes after a node drain.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout started: service=encoder, batch=shadowing, id=roll-202311-enc-v2, initiated by suman.r
oncall-bot: @sre-rotation: incident page triggered (P1) — 5xx spike on /generate from 13:02 UTC, automated anomaly detection.
jacob.s: I'm on it — can you paste the pod logs and HPA metrics?
maria.p: paste: ```kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=encoder -o wide
NAME                          READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
encoder-v2-5c7b9d6fd-2j9qg    0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   6          12m
encoder-v2-5c7b9d6fd-km4pz    1/1     Running            0          22m
encoder-v1-8f4d7c6d-ptz4r    1/1     Running            0          5h
```

maria.p: logs (encoder-v2-5c7b9d6fd-2j9qg): ```2024-09-23T13:03:04.123Z ERROR OOM killer invoked: allocation failed at KV cache write
2024-09-23T13:03:04.125Z INFO Dumping heap to /tmp/heap
2024-09-23T13:03:05.200Z FATAL OutOfMemoryError: requested 512MB
```

eric.k: HPA shows CPU thrash — replicas flapping 2 <-> 8 due to spike in init containers during startup (bootstrapping cache). metrics: cpu.avg=82% 1m, memory.avg=74% 1m, events: node-drain triggered earlier 12:58 UTC.
suman.r: That drain was a routine scale down from maintenance window — we shadowed traffic to v2 during the roll. I thought v2 had prefix caching disabled for short-lived pods, maybe config didn't apply to init container.
jacob.s: Two-pronged mitigation: 1) Pause rollout (stop creating new v2 replicas) 2) Flip shadowing off so no new requests hit v2 3) Set HPA minReplicas=3 to stop thrash. Anyone can run the pause?
dana: I can flip the flag — where is the feature toggle?
maria.p: feature flag is `encoder_shadowing` in LaunchDarkly — I have access. Pausing now.
maria.p: @deploy-bot pause-rollout roll-202311-enc-v2 -> ACKed.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused (id=roll-202311-enc-v2). new replica creation stopped.
maria.p: Turning off `encoder_shadowing` in LD -> done. Please confirm no traffic to v2.
jacob.s: Confirmed: 0 requests to v2 in last 30s. Good. Next: adjust HPA and remove bad init cache config on v2 pods (temp fix: reduce init container memory to 256Mi). Who can patch?
eric.k: I can patch a quick emergency manifest: `kubectl patch deployment encoder-v2 -n prod --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"initContainers":[{"name":"cache-init","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"256Mi"},"requests":{"memory":"128Mi"}}}]}}}}'` run now?
suman.r: Do it but keep one stable v2 up for diagnostics. Also we should node-evict the crashlooping pod to force reschedule away from drained nodes.
jacob.s: Before that, customer impact check — we had 5xx spike ~2.5% of requests for 3 minutes, affecting internal API consumers and some low-latency customers. No billing impact reported. SLOs impacted for 10-minute window. I'll start incident doc.
dana: Patch applied and evicted crashlooping pod -> pod rescheduled and back to Running after a cold start.
maria.p: Thank you. Any further elevated errors?
eric.k: Memory usage stabilized after patch: encoder-v2 memory 48% avg now. HPA steady at 4 replicas. No new 5xx at /generate in the last 4m.
suman.r: Root cause hypothesis: init container memory allocation had a default inherited value from v1 manifest; combined with shadowed traffic during node churn it led to OOM spin. We'll add a manifest guard in CI to prevent init memory > 512Mi for shadowed rollouts.
jacob.s: Agreed. Action items: (1) revert any partial rollout artifacts and keep shadowing disabled until fix merged (owner: suman.r) (2) CI manifest guard PR (owner: eng-platform) (3) Postmortem and customer comms (owner: maria.p) (4) Consider adding a pod annotation to opt-out of HPA scaling during canary for init-heavy workloads (owner: jacob.s).
maria.p: I'm taking postmortem and will draft a short customer-facing note (no PII). Sending handoff to next oncall in 20m.
oncall-bot: Handoff scheduled -> new oncall: jacob.s at 13:30 UTC. Incident ticket INC-2024-6412 created.
jacob.s: Taking handoff. I'll keep the incident open until the CI guard lands. Marking as mitigated for paging. :white_check_mark:
